description: Find American Ghost Walks ghost and history walking tours by city, optionally with a date range and party size. Returns tour ids, names, descriptions, duration, meeting spot and price, plus open departures when dates are given. Call with no city to list every city and tour. Use a tour id from the results with the other tools.

city.description: City or area name to filter tours. Examples: 'Chicago', 'Old San Juan', 'Viejo San Juan', 'Twin Cities', 'LA', 'Saint Paul'. Omit this field entirely to list every city and tour (do not pass an empty string).

end_date.description: Last local calendar date to check, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after start_date and at most 14 days after it. Defaults to start_date when omitted.

party_size.description: Number of guests (integer 1-50). When set with dates, departures that cannot fit this party are omitted.

start_date.description: First local calendar date to check for open departures, as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-11-08'). Requires city.

name: search_tours
title: Search American Ghost Walks tours
